label: D2 on reaching S2, early in the episode (first ~15 trials)
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (100% of mass; never D1, ~0 at GO), and only early in the episode: rate 22% on trial 0, 8% on trials 3-9, 3% on 10-19, about 0 after trial 40. Within that window it prefers the S2 state input (89% of mass; 4.7x lift) and is somewhat higher after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward 0: 1.8x vs 0.6x) and after rare transitions. Magnitude is largest on the first trials of the episode and drops with ep_trial. The predicate D2 & ep_trial<15 & state S2 gets dev P=0.32 R=0.62 F1=0.42 and mass recall 0.73; widening to ep_trial<20 raises mass recall to 0.82 but lowers precision to 0.25. Precision is limited because many early S2 D2 steps stay silent, especially after runs of rewarded trials; adding prev_reward, good state, value or policy-uncertainty terms did not lift F1 above ~0.43. Best read as an early-episode transient on D2/S2 that is suppressed by recent reward. No future variables are used.
